children: Ispire Technology published an updated investor presentation highlighting $96M of TTM revenue and expanded Malaysian manufacturing capacity.
Published updated investor presentation on Sept 22, 2026, attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K.
Reported $96M trailing twelve months revenue as of June 30, 2026; e-cigarettes comprised 84% of TTM revenue.
Malaysia manufacturing footprint: completed 31,000 sq ft facility, production started 2025, expanding to 136,000 sq ft with capacity up to 61M devices/month.
Company cites path to cash-flow breakeven in 2026 via shift to Ispire-owned Malaysian production and margin expansion.
Highlighted technologies and market catalysts: G-Mesh atomization, IKE age-gating/authentication, nicotine pouch production and FDA age-gating regulatory pathway.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Ispire Technology updates investor presentation; cites $96M TTM revenue, Malaysia manufacturing capacity
